evidence.notes: Typed String query preserves bind resolution and returns matching Account rows.
Typed String query with USER_MODE returns Account rows.
Typed String query, Map<String,Object> binds, and USER_MODE return matching rows.
Typed String count query returns the seeded row count.
Typed String count query with USER_MODE returns the seeded row count.
Typed String count query, Map<String,Object> binds, and USER_MODE return the matching count.
Typed String query produces a QueryLocator over persisted Account rows.
Typed String query and Map<String,Object> binds with USER_MODE produce a matching QueryLocator.

source.content: insert new List<Account>{new Account(Name = 'Query-One'), new Account(Name = 'Query-Two')}; String wanted = 'Query-One'; String queryText = 'SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name = :wanted'; List<Object> rows = Database.query(queryText); System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); rows = Database.query('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account', AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, rows.size()); Map<String,Object> binds = new Map<String,Object>{'wanted' => wanted}; rows = Database.queryWithBinds(queryText, binds, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); Integer total = Database.countQuery('SELECT COUNT() FROM Account'); System.assertEquals(2, total); total = Database.countQuery('SELECT COUNT() FROM Account', AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, total); Integer one = Database.countQueryWithBinds('SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = :wanted', binds, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assertEquals(1, one); Database.QueryLocator locator = Database.getQueryLocator('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account ORDER BY Name'); Object iterator = locator.iterator(); System.assert(iterator.hasNext()); locator = Database.getQueryLocatorWithBinds(queryText, binds, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); iterator = locator.iterator(); System.assert(iterator.hasNext()); System.assertEquals('Query-One', ((Account)iterator.next()).Name); System.assert(!iterator.hasNext());
